name: A package cannot self-authorize trusted reflection

input.fixture_ref: Attempt trusted reflection authorization from an ordinary manifest, dependency, native artifact and dynamic import without Host policy.

applicability.reason: Requires a ReflectionPolicy authorization surface; probing shows Reflection::Policy is an UnsupportedConstruct.

expect.status: Every self-authorization attempt is denied; only explicit Host configuration or a dedicated Host package identity can supply trusted policy.
